Re-open.

Maybe we can shorten the section text to:

> In particular, there are certain methods of deserialization where it has been made clear by the programming language or framework documentation (such as .NET's BinaryFormatter, and PHP unserialize) that they are insecure and cannot be made safe with untrusted data.

And remove the example from the requirement?

Re-open.

Maybe we can remove this link part?

> Yes, it feels weird to have this one example in the requirement: many other dangerous serialization technologies have been used in many other systems so we might wonder why this one has been picked as an example.
> 
> Having a list of example of dangerous serialization technologies would be nice but feels weird in the requirement. It would be better be found in some "ASVS companion" document :)

I think having an ASVS developer companion guide or even another dev standard would be a great idea and I'm sorry I didn't say so sooner.
